title: Yesterday I showed you my game, today I have a trailer
author: the-nooK
selftext:
Followup from my [Post yesterday](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1woyowz/3_months_into_ai_gamedev_building_an_idle_rpg_in/). Trailer was fully done by Claude Opus 5.5 with Godot Built-In Movie Tools.



**Moonlight Harvester: an idle/incremental HD-2D RPG made in Godot (pre-alpha)**

The Game is \~2 Weeks in development.



**What is in the Game right now:**

HD-2D pixel art in a moonlit 3D world

10 skills: Mining, Woodcutting, Fishing, Foraging, Farming, Combat, Cooking, Crafting, Shopkeeping and more

Every skill has its own zones, mechanics and passive tree

Multi-floor dungeons with active combat skills

PoE-style gear and item tooltips

Your own shop, plus town stations that keep working while you're away

Offline progress: your character keeps gathering while the game is closed

Two overworlds to explore, plus a town and quests

  
Planned:

More Skills (30+)

Bigger Overworld

Lots of polish

¯\\\_(ツ)\_/¯
